name: AutoECMs
old_description: Since 1994, AutoECMs has been a leading worldwide source for quality remanufactured automotive engine control modules.
about:
AutoECMs operates from Duryea, Pennsylvania, and has been supplying remanufactured automotive engine control modules since 1994. The company is privately held; no founder names or ownership structure are disclosed in public sources.

The company specializes in remanufacturing automotive electronic control modules, including engine control modules (ECMs), body control modules (BCMs), mass air flow sensors (MAFs), anti-lock brake system modules (ABS), transmission control modules (TCMs), and generic electronic modules (GEMs). Services include part number validation, module programming, and a core exchange program. No facility size, employee count, or production volumes are published.

AutoECMs serves the automotive aftermarket globally, supplying repair shops, distributors, and vehicle owners seeking refurbished electronic modules. The company markets its products worldwide through its e-commerce platform. No specific OEM contracts or named customers are mentioned in the available information.

The company emphasizes its long-standing presence as a worldwide source for quality remanufactured modules, though specific differentiators beyond its product breadth and validation services are not detailed in the provided materials.
